classification: CPU adjudication of source125 native residual/operator replay; no physical transaction, no nonlinear acceptance, and no certificate claim

interpretation.actions: Cached and uncached native operator actions are compared with exact captured unsymmetrized CSR action on the exported FP32 vector. CSR agreement is a captured-operator consistency check; it does not certify nonlinear descent or terminal convergence.
interpretation.alpha1: The native alpha=1 residual is an independently evaluated nonlinear residual at the exact trial from the production candidate/geometry/material-force/residual kernels; all reported sweep statuses are successful and accepted material history is byte-preserved.
interpretation.best_alpha: The reported best tested alpha is only the minimum residual norm among the sampled positive backtracking values 1,1/2,...,1/32. alpha=2 is reported in the curve but excluded from this Armijo-like candidate set.
interpretation.center: All three center files (candidate nodes, residual, internal element forces) are byte-identical across four profiles and to native424. This verifies replay center parity, not direction validity as an accepted Newton solve.
limitations: The run does not execute physical transactions or perform CCD/line-search acceptance.
The original Newton certificate applies only to its original captured correction, not any replacement direction.
Nonlinear residual evaluation at tested alpha is diagnostic only; even a lower residual is not an accepted physics step or proof of solver convergence.
No noise-floor or physical qualification claim is made.
Fixed source125/no-contact explicit FEM scope only; no cohesive, rigid, field, or other coupled rows.
interpretation.linear_curve: The CSR curve is b - alpha*A*p, with signed alpha for each measured side; it is a local linear prediction at the captured source125 center, not an Armijo acceptance or physical transaction.
